company.name: Indian Railway Finance Corporation Limited
company.tag: Raises money to finance trains and rail infrastructure and collects lease payments and loan interest.
company.productNote: Selected examples of work the company finances. The pictures illustrate what funding helps pay for; they do not show equipment manufactured or operated by this lender.

offerings.name: Locomotive finance

offerings.name: Passenger coach finance

offerings.name: Freight wagon finance
